```plato

// A one-degree-of-freedom translational joint (piston): the bodies slide
// along AxisA with relative rotation locked.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prismatic_joint)
type SliderJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    AxisA: Direction3D;
    Limit: LinearLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}
```
